title: Sub-200ms login vs mandatory hardware-key MFA
description: A latency budget and a security mandate collide on the same user action. The 200 ms budget assumes a single round trip, while FIDO2 attestation needs user presence plus a challenge-response round trip.
req_a: Login shall complete in under 200 ms on a 3G connection.
req_b: Login shall require FIDO2 hardware-key attestation on every sign-in.
resolution: Risk-based step-up: passwordless fast path for low-risk sessions, hardware key only for high-risk actions.
